import unittest

from solution import SecretEnvelope


class CopyProbe:
    deepcopy_calls = 0

    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        type(self).deepcopy_calls += 1
        copied = type(self)([dict(item) for item in self.values])
        memo[id(self)] = copied
        return copied


class SecretEnvelopeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_mutable_payload_is_deep_copied_on_construction(self):
        original = {"items": [1, {"nested": [2]}]}
        envelope = SecretEnvelope(original)

        original["items"].append(3)
        original["items"][1]["nested"].append(4)

        self.assertTrue(envelope.available())
        self.assertEqual(envelope.consume(), {"items": [1, {"nested": [2]}]})
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())

    def test_consume_performs_a_second_deep_copy(self):
        CopyProbe.deepcopy_calls = 0
        original = CopyProbe([{"value": 1}])
        envelope = SecretEnvelope(original)

        self.assertEqual(CopyProbe.deepcopy_calls, 1)
        consumed = envelope.consume()

        self.assertEqual(CopyProbe.deepcopy_calls, 2)
        self.assertIsNot(consumed, original)
        self.assertIsNot(consumed.values, original.values)
        self.assertIsNot(consumed.values[0], original.values[0])

        consumed.values[0]["value"] = 9
        self.assertEqual(original.values, [{"value": 1}])
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())

    def test_nested_result_does_not_alias_original(self):
        original = [{"x": [1]}]
        envelope = SecretEnvelope(original)
        consumed = envelope.consume()

        self.assertIsNot(consumed, original)
        self.assertIsNot(consumed[0], original[0])
        self.assertIsNot(consumed[0]["x"], original[0]["x"])

        consumed[0]["x"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(original, [{"x": [1]}])

    def test_empty_mutable_payload_is_present_and_one_use(self):
        envelope = SecretEnvelope([])

        self.assertTrue(envelope.available())
        consumed = envelope.consume()
        self.assertEqual(consumed, [])
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())
        self.assertIsNone(envelope.consume())

    def test_none_is_present_until_consumed(self):
        envelope = SecretEnvelope(None)

        self.assertTrue(envelope.available())
        self.assertIsNone(envelope.consume())
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())
        self.assertIsNone(envelope.consume())

    def test_immutable_payload_is_one_use(self):
        envelope = SecretEnvelope("secret")

        self.assertTrue(envelope.available())
        self.assertEqual(envelope.consume(), "secret")
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())
        self.assertIsNone(envelope.consume())
        self.assertFalse(envelope.available())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
